mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts above 1.3 million units and consumer spending (RSAFS) above 700 billion dollars indicates robust economic expansion that increases corporate revenue visibility, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 700000.0, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.5% compresses corporate debt financing and signals reduced liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% during tightening cycles, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 150,000 thousand supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% combined with housing starts above 1.3 million units signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1300.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals tight labor markets with monetary tightening, increasing corporate borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 index level signals reduced manufacturing output and lower corporate capacity utilization, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during industrial contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 during contraction, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
